build.name: pip install the acquired source (+ pinned deps)
build.cmd: pip install -q  . 2>&1 | grep -v -i 'notice\|warning' | tail -2; python -c 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'

runs.name: identify (Techne harness, oracle-backed; same-container install + run)

notes: Oracle: NLMS and RLS recover a known 4-tap FIR plant from input/output pairs (max |w-h| < 0.02) and re-converge after the plant changes mid-run.
